releaseNotes: MR Marked Location Update Fix: Fixed marked location updating in mobile and web so batch changes, removal, GPS pin adjustments, clinic names, and phone numbers persist accurately without rejection
Tour Plan Batch-Specific Location Discovery: Monthly TP directly displays saved locations belonging to the selected route batch with interactive checkboxes and automatic KOL doctor linking

Strict Multi-HQ Territory & Batch Isolation: Guaranteed that Field Representatives only see their own headquarters' batches and marked locations, eliminating cross-territory data exposure between Kotma, Shahdol, and other HQs
Admin Web Route Batch Assignment: Admin interactive map modal now features a Route Batch Circuit selector so admins can assign clinics to route batches directly when creating or updating locations
